LESSON: SIGN READING 8.2.1 INTENSIVE SIGN READING

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.2: Sign Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading, part of Strand 8 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you identify the subject in a poem? 2. How are poems similar to songs?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 8.2.1 Intensive Sign Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learners develop the skill of interacting with technology skills as they create a word puzzle and share them online

using digital devices.

● Critical thinking and problem-solving: Learners develop the skill of interpretation and inference as they interpret and evaluate issues

highlighted in poems and relate them to real life.

Values:
Respect: is enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinions as they work together.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate intensive sign reading skill to their learning in all other subjects.
